chrome-devtools.description: ADR-0038 (Issues #174, #224, #220; D8 of 2026-10-29). A browser for product-lead's read-only sweep. Since #224 it always attaches to the owner's own running Chrome (--autoConnect, the stable channel's default profile), so it drives a browser holding his logins and Chrome asks him to allow the connection, in any project whose agent calls it. Since D8 there is no origin bound: no --allowedUrlPattern is passed and no environment variable is read, so the agent may navigate any site in his Chrome; the owner accepted the prompt-injection risk that carries. The package is pinned to one exact version and fetched with install scripts off.
